summary: Great Blitz, but too hard for a daily once the data is right. The casual player found 6, and one of them, Berkshire at #10, is only there because CVS still shows its 2023 revenue.
reasons: Casual found 6 (Walmart, Amazon, Apple, Google, Aramco, Berkshire) before Microsoft #19, Exxon #13, Toyota #17, Nvidia #27 and Samsung #33 took all five lives by guess 11. Each miss teaches something, but nearly every famous company is in the pool, so lives go fast. State Grid, CNPC and Sinopec are out of reach for most players.

That 6 rests on mixed-year data: Alphabet is #8 on 2025 revenue while CVS sits #11 on its 2023 figure, though the 2024 and 2025 Fortune Global 500 both have CVS in the top 10. With CVS corrected, Berkshire drops to #11 and the casual finds 5 (crowd estimate about 4.6), so this is free play, not fix-first.

Blitz is excellent: 21 of 24 quick casual names scored, and natural spellings work (wal-mart, aramco, cnpc, petrochina, united health, berkshire). The fan got 10/10 with 2 lives lost, one of them on CVS.
fixes: TotalEnergies is missing. SKIP_NAME in scripts/build.ts begins `^(totals?|` with no word boundary, so the source's #26 TotalEnergies ($218B) is dropped as a total row and every entry from Glencore down shows one rank too high (Nvidia #27, source #28). Make it `totals?\b`; the same bug can drop any name starting with 'Total' on other lists.

Values mix years: Amazon, Walmart, Apple, Alphabet and Nvidia show 2025 revenue; Aramco, UnitedHealth and Berkshire 2024; CVS, Volkswagen, Exxon, Shell, State Grid, Sinopec and most of 11-50 still show 2023 figures (refs are Fortune pages retrieved in 2022). That decides the top-10 cut: CVS Health reported about $373B for 2024, above Berkshire's $371B. Refresh at least CVS Health, ideally every row from one year or source, then re-rank.

Amazon's old-domain aliases 'Bookworm.com' and 'Relentless.com' make the plain words 'bookworm' and 'relentless' autocorrect to #1 Amazon. Add them and the other Amazon domain redirects (Look.com, Casa.com, Wag.com, Yoyo.com, BeautyBar.com, AfterSchool.com, Myhabit.com, Unboxed.com) to junkAliases.
Alias gaps (free misses today): 'Sinopec Group' (Fortune's name for #6), 'VW' for Volkswagen, 'AmerisourceBergen' for Cencora (its name until 2023), 'Hon Hai' for Foxconn.

Junk redirects on ranks 11+: people (Shigeru Hayakawa on Toyota, Savita Subramanian on Bank of America, Shilpan Amin on General Motors), slogans and addresses (Move fast and break things, Hacker Way on Meta; Bank of opportunity, Blue chip investor on Bank of America; EVerybody in on General Motors), 'IReady' on Nvidia, 'Project Solidgold' on China Construction Bank, 'New Auto' on Volkswagen.
